title: A Fujita-type threshold for the semilinear damped wave equation with Hartree-type nonlinearity and initial data from homogeneous Besov spaces
summary: In this paper, we consider the semilinear damped wave equation with Hartree-type nonlinearity $\mathcal{I}_γ\left(|u|^{p_1}\right)|u|^{p_2}$, where $0 0$. This formulation is particularly suited to the nonlinear analysis. We then establish the existence of a unique global mild solution for sufficiently small initial data whenever $$ p_1+p_2\geq 1+\frac{4+2γ}{n+2β}, $$ under the remaining admissibility conditions stated in the existence theorem.
